pages.title: Lightweight
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Mace$(br2)§lEffect: §r Holding a mace increases attack speed, letting the heavy weapon swing faster.$(br2)Attack speed: +0.2 / +0.4 / +0.6$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br)Only applies while a mace is held in the main hand.
